info.title: Atomicals Marketplace v1 authority
info.summary: Four isolated protocol authorities for ARC-20, plain NFTs, Realms, and Subrealms.
info.description:
A durable protocol authority backed by Atomicals ElectrumX, Bitcoin Core, and the token-explorer database. It does not infer ownership from an address string or from indexer metadata alone. Every listing, reservation, purchase preparation, signed transaction, and broadcast is checked against one stable Bitcoin and Atomicals checkpoint.

One router exposes four isolated protocol authorities. They share the durable transaction engine and operational credentials, but every route, cursor, idempotency scope, listing, offer, order, reservation, browse query, and status count is protocol scoped.

Every marketplace and action gate defaults to false. Documentation of a capability is not a statement that it is enabled on any deployment.

Every amount is a decimal string. JSON numbers are rejected for satoshi and protocol quantities.

IdempotencyKey.description: One key per logical action, reused for every retry of that action. Scoped per protocol lane.

AtomicAmount.description: Decimal string. JSON numbers are rejected for satoshi and protocol quantities.

Contract.description: Machine readable route and signing contract for this protocol lane.

Status.description: A non-probing status view. It does not contact Bitcoin Core or the Atomicals provider.

Readiness.description: Performs the Bitcoin Core and Atomicals checkpoint probe. Binds the deployed revision and the settlement authority identity so a stale binary or a confused authority is rejected before wallet preparation.

assetId.description: For ARC-20 the resolved ticker winner. For the non-fungible lanes an authoritative compact Atomical ID. Never a prefixed storage key.

quantityAtomic.description: Always 1 for the three non-fungible lanes.

message.description: The exact message to sign with a BIP-322 simple proof. Signing it moves nothing.

signature.description: BIP-322 simple proof, message type smp, for P2WPKH or key-path P2TR.

session.description: Present it in X-Marketplace-Owner-Authorization. Short lived by design.

PreparedAction.description: Everything the wallet must sign, with the exact scope it must use.

psbt.description: PSBT v0. Seller preparations have one collateral input, one payout output, sequence 0xfffffffd, and a witness UTXO.

sighash.description: Seller preparations use 0x83, SIGHASH_SINGLE with ANYONECANPAY. Buyer P2WPKH inputs require SIGHASH_ALL; key-path P2TR allows default or ALL.

psbt.description: The signed PSBT. It must preserve the prepared unsigned digest, exact previous outputs, output ordering, miner fee, fee-rate ceiling, and the Atomicals transfer blueprint.

protocolData.description: Exact. Listing validation accepts location and an optional payoutAddress.
Exact. Update accepts an optional payoutAddress only.
Exact. Delist accepts an empty object.

buyerInputs.description: One of the maximum 64 ordered spend claims is reserved for collateral. Inputs must be confirmed and uncoloured.

Reservation.description: The complete stored projection. Reload and purchase preparation both recompute and compare it, and wallet supplied mutations are rejected.

economicHash.description: Uses the bitcoin-universe:marketplace-v1:purchase-reservation-economics:v1 schema and commits an absent optional requestId as JSON null.

protocolData.description: Exact. Offer creation accepts listingId and expectedListingRevision.

evidence.description: Bitcoin Core transaction, mempool, block header, spending prevout, and UTXO evidence. Replacement, drop, conflict, and reorganisation evidence is recorded rather than guessed.

AdapterPage.description: Envelope free adapter page. Exactly items and an optional nextCursor.

PositionSourceResult.description: Uses universe-marketplace-protocol-position-v1 and contains only positions from that protocol. Spent and unrelated outputs return a complete empty set. Mixed, unknown, non-standard, or internally inconsistent Atomicals fail closed rather than disappearing from composite evidence.

InternalActionRequest.description: Exactly three fields. It must contain no walletAuth key.

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid credentials, or an invalid signature.

Conflict.description: An idempotency mismatch, a revision conflict, or an active reservation. Inspect rather than retrying with a new key.

FailedClosed.description: A verification view disagreed, or the checkpoint moved mid-check. Nothing was spent.

NotFound.description: Missing, expired, consumed, or out of scope.

Bitcoin Core and Atomicals checkpoint probe

post.description: Signing the returned message proves control of the address without moving anything.

post.summary: Verify a BIP-322 proof and issue an owner session

post.description: Resolves the asset to its verified winner and verifies the collateral against Bitcoin Core and the Atomicals provider under one stable checkpoint. Mixed collateral, spent outputs, checkpoint drift, ambiguous balances, Atomicals operations, and burns are all rejected.
The authority verifies the signature before persisting a live listing.
A price change is not a metadata edit. Collateral is re-verified at a fresh checkpoint.
Removes the offer to sell. It moves nothing on chain, because a listing never moved anything.
Buyer funding inputs must be confirmed P2WPKH or key-path P2TR outputs and must be uncoloured in both the active script hash view and location history.

get.description: Recomputes and compares the entire stored projection. Wallet supplied mutations are rejected.

post.description: Deterministic ordering: input 0 is the first buyer funding input, inputs 1 through N are seller inputs in request order, remaining inputs are the remaining buyer funding inputs, output 0 receives the complete asset amount, outputs 1 through N are the seller payouts, the marketplace fee output follows when non-zero, and buyer change is last when it is not dust.
Performs Atomicals dry validation and Bitcoin Core testmempoolaccept before writing a durable broadcast intent. A failure here costs nothing.
A transport failure after a durable broadcast intent is an ambiguous outcome and never triggers a blind rebroadcast.
Buy or offer execution additionally requires an exact fee scriptPubKey to be configured on the deployment.
